## 2026-07-07 - Reviewer Check: Live Miner Survives Cold Manifest And Shadow-Ready Centers

STATUS:

```text
The live-tail daemon crashed when cold artifact refresh tried to load a
call/token promotion manifest whose route table had duplicate route_id rows.

That was wrong for product behavior:
  cold manifest/package work must never kill the live online miner.
```

FIX APPLIED:

```text
crates/nando-cli/src/phase_streaming_cmd/live_store_adapter.rs
crates/nando-core/src/wave/phase_center_runtime.rs

Manifest loader:
  - groups promoted profiles by route_id before building PhaseCenterHotRouteTable
  - keeps stable route_index per route_id in call/token manifests
  - ignores invalid active/promotion manifests fail-closed at startup
  - validates a promotion manifest before copying it to active

Online miner score path:

  - adds shadow_ready centers:
      active bucket
      positive + negative evidence present
      calibration window completed
      threshold learned from false margins

    unique CPU accept, so new centers are not stuck in a chicken/egg loop
```

## 2026-07-08 - Reviewer Check: Adaptive Online Phase-Center Repair

STATUS:

```text
Relevant auto-subcenters were visible, but broad centers were permanently
rejected after late false accepts:
  state_exit_code family center: rejected=true, false_accepts=59+
  command/shape pair centers: also rejected after first late false

That made the miner brittle:
  a center could learn useful margins, then one late false killed it forever.
```

FIX APPLIED:

```text
crates/nando-core/src/wave/phase_center_runtime.rs

False accept handling changed:
  - late false_accept no longer permanently rejects the bucket
  - miner raises learned_threshold_micro to false_margin + 1
  - false_accepts remain counted
  - buckets with false_accepts > 0 are still excluded from package/export/promotion
  - shadow scoring can continue so the online miner can self-repair

crates/nando-cli/src/phase_streaming_cmd/live_store_adapter.rs

Auto-subcenter discovery changed:
  - adds generic pair subcenters:
      state_exit_code_band:* + request_command_kind:<specific>
      state_exit_code_band:* + tool_command_kind:<specific>
      state_exit_code_band:* + tool_check_kind:<specific>
      state_exit_code_band:* + shadow_active_fringe_len_band:<band>
      state_exit_code_band:* + shadow_slot_count_band:<band>
  - generic `other` command kind remains blocked as standalone command evidence
  - source/session/cwd/target/proof/local_out_t remain forbidden
```

## 2026-07-07 - Reviewer Check: Live Miner Hot/Cold Split Applied

STATUS:

```text
The append live-tail daemon was doing cold artifact work inside each heartbeat:
candidate .nwpc package writes, promotion manifests, billing requests, and
provider evidence refresh.

That was wrong for a smart/fast online miner.
```

FIX APPLIED:

```text
crates/nando-cli/src/phase_streaming_cmd/live_store_adapter.rs

Hot heartbeat now stays light:
  reads appended rows
  scores before update
  observes into online phase-center store
  writes heartbeat report

Cold artifact refresh is throttled:
  DEFAULT_HOT_PATH_DAEMON_APPEND_LIVE_TAIL_COLD_REFRESH_SECS = 60
  no candidate package/manifest/provider refresh on every heartbeat

Per-row candidate freezing removed from hot path:
  freeze_new_live_store_candidates_from_store(...)
  now runs only inside cold artifact refresh / final report path

Idle loop now backs off up to 1000 ms when no new rows arrive.

Warm-history event buffers are cleared after store initialization.

Decision log flush is batched:
  DEFAULT_HOT_PATH_DAEMON_APPEND_LIVE_TAIL_DECISION_FLUSH_ROWS = 64
  heartbeat/final still flush for evidence durability

Product-hot quarantine is now restart-stable:
  previous report product_hot_score_only_quarantined_profile_ids
  is loaded at daemon startup

Clean call/token .nwpc handoff is now restart-stable:
  current report manifest may be overwritten by an empty live window
  active manifest is written only when allowed=true
  startup loads active manifest before the old env product-hot registry
```

## 2026-07-07 - P0 Architecture Polish: Online Miner Fast Wins

GOAL:

```text
Polish the online miner daemon itself.
Fast wins only.
No provider/billing side quests.
No local_accept.
No .nwrb.
No manual class list.
```

HARD PRODUCT CONSTRAINT - DAEMON MUST BE LIGHT AND CONTROLLABLE:

```text
The online miner daemon must not be an always-on CPU furnace.
It must be able to pause, throttle, sample, and shut down safely.
```

REQUIRED RUNTIME MODES:

```text
OFF:
  no mining
  no scoring
  no background CPU burn

SHADOW_LIGHT:
  sample only a bounded fraction of events
  low CPU budget
  no compile storm
  no local_accept

BURST_DISCOVERY:
  temporary high-effort mining window
  explicit duration / row budget / CPU budget
  auto-return to SHADOW_LIGHT or OFF

PRODUCT_HOT_SCORE_ONLY:
  score already selected hot packages
  no learning/compile in request path
  strict latency budget
```

REQUIRED BUDGET CONTROLS:

```text
cpu_budget_percent:
  default <= 5-10% background
  burst may use more only with explicit command

row_budget:
  max rows per run/window

time_budget:
  max wall-clock seconds per mining burst

compile_budget:
  max checkpoint compiles per window
  max .nwpc writes per window

bucket_budget:
  max active buckets
  max candidate buckets
  evict low-value buckets

io_budget:
  decisions log rotation or cap
  rolling reports, no unbounded JSONL growth

memory_budget:
  hot package cap
  cold bucket memory cap
```

REQUIRED CONTROL SURFACE:

```text
pause:
  stop mining after current row

resume:
  continue from checkpoint/log

stop:
  write partial report and exit cleanly

throttle:
  reduce sample rate / compile rate

status:
  rows processed
  buckets
  CPU mode
  current tokens_saved candidate
  false_accepts
  next compile ETA
```

DESIGN RULE:

```text
Learning/mining is cold or burst path.
Product request path is score-only.

Never put compile, JSONL scan, report aggregation, or large bucket search in
the hot request path.
```

NEXT ACCEPTABLE DAEMON IMPROVEMENT MUST REPORT:

```text
daemon_mode:
cpu_budget_percent:
row_budget:
time_budget:
compile_budget:
sample_rate:
partial_report_on_stop: true
pause_resume_supported:
hot_path_learning_enabled: false
product_hot_score_only_supported:
```

CURRENT ARCHITECTURE READ:

```text
stream row
  -> L4 atoms: request/state/tool/route_hint
  -> event bucket specs:
       broad_action
       state_action_signature
       auto_subcenter
       hidden_state_split
       learned_auto_subcenter
  -> score_future_event_before_update()
  -> update_online_bucket()
  -> checkpoint compile
  -> product-hot selector
  -> final report
```

FAST WIN 1 - Broad Action Must Become Parent-Only:

```text
Current risk:
  online_miner_bucket_immediate_checkpoint_allowed() returns true only for
  broad_action.

Observed result:
  broad_action got large raw accepts but also huge false_accepts:
    tokens: 2383976
    unique_accept_rows: 1133
    false_accept_rows: 126

Required change:
  broad_action must not be promoted/product-hot.
  broad_action should exist only to detect split pressure and generate child
  subcenters.

Expected effect:
  fewer dirty hot slots
  cleaner active runtime set
  more room for learned_auto_subcenter / hidden_state_split
```

FAST WIN 2 - Immediate Checkpoint For Clean/Near-Clean Subcenters:

```text
Current risk:
  immediate bucket checkpoint is broad_action-only.
  Good subcenters wait for periodic compile ticks.

Required change:
  allow immediate checkpoint for:
    learned_auto_subcenter
    hidden_state_split
    high-value auto_subcenter

Gate:
  events_seen >= min_bucket_events
  positive_events > 0
  negative_events > 0
  non_exact_positive_events > 0
  value_score > 0
  source-neutral bucket key

Expected effect:
  clean subcenters start scoring future rows earlier
  less latency between discovery and savings
```

FAST WIN 3 - Counterexample-Driven Asymmetric Split:

```text
Near-clean buckets are the money:
  shell_inspect:
    tokens: 2417256
    false_accept_rows: 4

  sed/shell variants:
    tokens: 1.5M-1.7M
    false_accept_rows: 1-3

Required mechanism:
  for each near-clean bucket with false_accept_rows > 0:
    collect false rows
    compare atoms against true accepted rows
    generate child split candidates:
      include positive-island atoms
      exclude negative/counterexample atoms
    compile child buckets
    keep only zero-false children

Do not manually name sed/shell. The splitter must discover this from false rows.
```

FAST WIN 4 - Product-Hot Selector Must Optimize Marginal Tokens, Not Accept Count:

```text
Current selector already does marginal dedupe, but ordering still compares
unique_accepts before tokens in OnlineMinerProductHotMarginalGain.

Required product metric:
  primary: marginal tokens_saved over exact cache
  secondary: marginal cost_saved
  tertiary: marginal unique accepts
  hard gate: false_accepts = 0

Why:
  money is in tokens/cost, not just call count.
```

FAST WIN 5 - Always Emit A Partial/Fallback Report:

```text
Observed:
  decisions.jsonl exists for the 5k daemon run
  final report path was missing

Required:
  write rolling progress report every compile tick
  write final-or-partial report on normal errors where possible
  include blocker if final product-hot registry cannot be written

Do not leave us with decisions.jsonl but no report.
```

NEXT ACCEPTABLE RESULT:

```text
immediate_subcenter_checkpoint_enabled: true
counterexample_split_enabled: true
```

## 2026-07-07 - Reviewer Check: Threshold Floor Safety Fix Lifted Targeted NWPC Shadow

VERDICT:

```text
Fixed online miner auto-calibration so it cannot lower the train-safe package
threshold.

Before:
  threshold = future_calibration_false_max + 1
  This could drop below the .nwpc compile-time safe floor and create unsafe
  accepts/reject useful packages.

After:
  threshold = max(train_safe_threshold, future_calibration_false_max + 1)

This is not manual threshold tuning. It is a safety invariant: later
calibration may tighten the threshold, never weaken it.
```

## 2026-07-07 - Reviewer Direction: Add L4 Hidden-State Search, Source-Neutral

TASK:

```text
Use hidden state to improve automatic streaming class discovery.

Current search mostly sees:
  event -> visible atoms -> bucket -> phase-center

The next architecture should add:
  event stream
    -> visible atoms
    -> inferred hidden state z_t
    -> candidate operator
    -> predicted/result state
    -> verifier
    -> shadow/promote only after false_accepts = 0
```

WHY:

```text
Broad classes such as agent_continue_execute / planning / run_check are too
wide on the surface. They contain several hidden process phases:
  plan
  run tool
  parse result
  fix error
  report

If L4 can infer z_t from the stream, L3 phase-center gets cleaner transition
classes:
  z_t + action -> z_t+1

This should improve split discovery and reduce false accepts without manual
class lists.
```

BOUNDARY:

```text
Do not hardcode Codex as architecture.
Codex/session/tool names may exist only in source adapters.
The generic mechanism must be source-neutral:
  visible stream atoms -> inferred hidden state -> phase-center candidates

Forbidden as hidden-state authority:
  future LLM answer
  target/proof labels
  provider ids
  exact-cache ids
  output hash as answer authority
  route name alone
  manual class list
```

ACCEPTANCE:

```text
Report hidden-state discovery separately from old bucket discovery:
  hidden_state_count
  hidden_state_transition_count
  hidden_state_split_candidates
  unique accepts over exact cache
  tokens saved
  false_accepts
  wrong_wins
  product_hot accepts
  local_accept_enabled = false
  market_money_claim_allowed = false

Promotion remains blocked until verifier-bound false_accepts = 0.
```

## 2026-07-07 - Reviewer Check: Online Miner Learned Compound Multi-Split Wired

VERDICT:

```text
The online miner learned registry now observes compound split atoms, not only
single atoms.

  learned_auto_subcenter could learn only single observable atoms.
```

## 2026-07-07 - Reviewer Architecture Note: Asymmetric Phase Cutter

VERDICT:

```text
Good news: the current direction now has the right name and the right frame.

This is no longer "find one phase center for a broad class".
The architecture should be understood as:

  Asymmetric Phase Cutter

Russian working name:
  Несимметричный фазовый резчик
```

MEANING:

```text
asymmetric:
  false_accept is forbidden
  false_reject is acceptable because fallback to LLM exists

phase:
  decisions happen in phase/representation space

cutter:
  L4 cuts broad traffic into safe local regions
  L3 gives each surviving region a local phase center
```

ARCHITECTURE:

```text
real stream
|
+-- L4 asymmetric phase cutter
|     |
|     +-- automatic candidate splits
|     +-- survival feedback from .nwpc runtime
|     +-- reject unsafe/unknown rows
|
+-- L3 multi-phase centers
|     |
|     +-- many local centers
|     +-- each center covers a small safe island
|
+-- portfolio selector
|     |
|     +-- keep centers with false_accepts = 0
|     +-- rank by runtime unique accepts over exact cache
|
+-- fallback to LLM
      |
      +-- everything not safely covered
```

CORE OBJECTIVE:

```text
maximize CPU coverage / tokens saved
subject to:
  false_accepts = 0
  runtime replay parity = 0 mismatches
  no local_accept without verifier
```

WHY THIS MATTERS:

```text
The broad 5_657 rows are not one sphere.
They are many islands.

So the winning mechanism is:
  multi-split
  multi-center
  asymmetric reject/fallback
  survival-feedback portfolio
```

CURRENT CONFIRMATION:

```text
clean runtime has moved:
  18 -> 52 -> 82 -> 187

This supports the cutter/portfolio direction.
Do not regress back to one magic center or manual class lists.
```

## 2026-07-07 - P0 Learned Multi-Split Registry + Specificity Budget

VERDICT:

```text
Added a stream-learned split registry for online phase-center miner.

The miner now maintains per-action split atom statistics from past events and can
route future events into learned_auto_subcenter buckets. Current-row evidence is
not allowed to create its own subcenter before scoring; split registry updates
happen after bucket scoring/update for that event.

First learned version proved the mechanism but regressed portfolio evidence.
Specificity-budget priority fixed the regression: precise state-action /
auto-subcenter checkpoints are compiled before broad learned subcenters.
```

Code:

```text
crates/nando-cli/src/phase_streaming_cmd/online_miner_daemon.rs
```

Mechanism:

```text
real event
  -> source-neutral split atoms
  -> learned split registry by action_family
  -> future event fanout into learned_auto_subcenter buckets
  -> quarantine .nwpc checkpoints
  -> selector/runtime replay

compile priority:
  state_action_signature > auto_subcenter > learned_auto_subcenter > broad_action
```

## 2026-07-06 - Reviewer P0: Automatic Continuation-Intent Split Before L3

VERDICT:

```text
The 5_657 -> 18 collapse is not primarily a billing/reporting problem.
It is a class-shape problem.

L4 is giving L3 a broad safe-looking bucket:
  result::evidence:exit_code_zero

But "command succeeded" is not the same as:
  "the next agent step is CPU-mechanical."

That bucket mixes:
  CPU-compressible mechanical continuations
  OpenAI-needed novel/explanatory/planning continuations

This split must be automatic, not a hand-written class list.
```

AUTOMATIC MECHANISM:

```text
broad selected split
|
+-- generate candidate sub-splits from stream atoms
|     |
|     +-- request atoms
|     +-- state atoms
|     +-- result atoms
|     +-- follow-up/action atoms
|     +-- verifier evidence atoms
|
+-- score every candidate sub-split by future evidence
|     |
|     +-- marginal unique accepts over exact cache
|     +-- false_accepts
|     +-- margin distribution
|     +-- token/cost delta
|     +-- support / MDL penalty
|
+-- keep only sub-splits that survive:
      |
      +-- false_accepts = 0
      +-- future_window_pass = true
      +-- runtime replay parity = 0
      +-- marginal_accepts_over_exact_cache > 0
```

THEOREM-STYLE RULE:

```text
Do not label rows manually as CPU or OpenAI.

Let the stream produce candidate separators.
Let future verifier evidence decide which separator is safe.

A sub-class is CPU-compressible only if:
  future verified accepts over exact cache are positive
  and future false_accepts are zero
  and the compiled phase-center runtime preserves the value.
```

P0 TASK:

```text
Build:
  phase-stream-automatic-continuation-split-v1

Input:
  selected broad splits from constrained split miner
  original stream rows
  verifier-bearing evidence rows

Output:
  automatically discovered continuation sub-splits
  CPU-ready sub-splits
  OpenAI-needed/background rows
  unknown rows

Then compile .nwpc only for CPU-ready sub-splits.
Treat OpenAI-needed/unknown rows as background negatives, not product accepts.
```

WHY THIS IS NEEDED:

```text
Current .nwpc packages use one center per broad split:
  package_records: 1

The broad class is too heterogeneous.
Threshold becomes high to protect false_accepts = 0:
  tool_status threshold: 308_915
  planning threshold: 241_085

Most true rows sit below threshold:
  tool_status median margin: 47_311
  planning median margin: 77_646

So safety works, but coverage collapses.
```

SUCCESS REPORT MUST SHOW:

```text
broad_split_accepts: 5_657
automatic_candidate_subsplits
selected_cpu_subsplits
rejected_openai_needed_or_unknown_rows
compiled_phase_subcenters
runtime_unique_accepts_over_exact_cache
runtime_tokens_saved
runtime_false_accepts
runtime_parity_mismatches

The key metric:
  compiled runtime accepts must move materially above 18
  without false_accepts.
```

RULE:

```text
No manual class list.
No manual "this is CPU" tagging.
No product local_accept.
No billing detour as the next step.

The missing boundary is automatic L4 -> L3 decomposition:
  find class -> split class -> compile safe phase subcenters.
```

## 2026-07-07 - P0 Auto-Subcenter Multi-Split Selector: Compound Centers Added, Offload Still Red

VERDICT:

```text
Auto-subcenter discovery now learns multi-split candidates instead of selecting
single broad status/tool atoms.
```

```text
  not a fake positive-only prefix.
```

## 2026-07-06 - Reviewer P0: Build L4 Constrained Split Miner, Not Manual Splits

VERDICT:

```text
Do not hand-pick safe sub-classes.
The product needs automatic streaming class discovery.

The next architecture node is:
  L4 Constrained Split Miner
```

ARCHITECTURE:

```text
broad unsafe class
|
+-- candidate split generator
|   |
|   +-- action atoms
|   +-- state atoms
|   +-- result/verifier atoms
|   +-- route/context atoms
|   +-- token/cost bands
|
+-- split scorer
|   |
|   +-- information gain / mutual information
|   +-- marginal denominator value
|   +-- cache overlap penalty
|   +-- MDL complexity penalty
|
+-- constrained accept gate
    |
    +-- Neyman-Pearson constraint:
        maximize saved calls/tokens/cost
        subject to false_accepts = 0
```

THEORY TO USE:

```text
1. CART / decision tree:
   split broad unsafe classes into candidate sub-classes.

2. Information gain / mutual information:
   choose splits that separate safe from unsafe evidence.

3. Neyman-Pearson:
   accept only sub-classes under strict false-accept constraint.

4. MDL:
   reject over-fragmentation; a split must buy enough value for its complexity.

5. Online bandit:
   learn which split families produce value on future stream windows.
```

OBJECTIVE:

```text
argmax split S:

  Gain(S)
    = Value(SafeChildren)
    - Value(Parent)
    - ComplexityPenalty(S)

subject to:

  false_accepts(child) = 0
  support(child) >= min_support
  future_window_pass(child) = true
  marginal_accepts_over_exact_cache(child) > 0
```

VALUE FUNCTION:

```text
Value =
  marginal_saved_calls
+ marginal_saved_tokens
+ estimated_saved_cost
- cache_overlap_penalty
- latency_penalty
- hot_memory_penalty
```

```text
can be safely executed on CPU instead of calling the LLM.

Provider billing is proof/evidence after that, not the source of value.
```

TREE:

```text
HTTP / agent stream
|
+-- L4 class miner / opportunity selector
|   |
|   +-- finds repeated action classes
|   +-- estimates class traffic share
|   +-- measures exact-cache overlap
|   +-- checks verifier availability
|   +-- ranks by marginal CPU value
|
+-- L3 phase-center operator
|   |
|   +-- learns transferable operator for the class
|   +-- scores future events before update
|   +-- produces shadow CPU accept/fallback
|
+-- verifier
|   |
|   +-- confirms equivalence
|   +-- false_accepts = 0
|
+-- CPU execution path
|   |
|   +-- local accept only after verifier gate
|   +-- saved call/tokens/cost estimate
|
+-- provider billing adapter
    |
    +-- later proves saved dollars with external billing rows
    +-- not the primary mechanism
```

SCOREBOARD CONTRACT:

```text
Primary product metrics:
  class_share_in_stream
```

```text
      split again or keep quarantined

   marginal unique accepts over exact cache

   marginal provider cost saved

   verifier evidence present
   runtime parity clean
   no manual class list authority
```

## 2026-07-06 - P0 Task For Executor: Learned L4 Savings Selector

WHY THIS IS P0:

```text
The money is not only in individual L3 .nwpc operators.
The money is in L4 learning which operator buckets are worth CPU budget.

L3 learns transferable actions.
L4 must learn the economic/action selection policy.
```

REQUIRED ARCHITECTURE:

```text
real stream
|
+-- L4 selector observes bucket outcomes
|   |
|   +-- accepted over exact cache
|   +-- tokens/cost saved
|   +-- false_accepts
|   +-- overlap with already selected portfolio
|   +-- hot bytes / latency
|
+-- L4 updates policy state
|   |
|   +-- learned bucket weights / priorities
|   +-- not just fixed greedy sorting
|
+-- L4 selects next portfolio candidates
|
+-- runtime replay + admission gate remain mandatory
```

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:

```text
Required new report fields:
  selector_policy_kind: learned_online
  fixed_greedy_baseline_report_path
  learned_selector_report_path
  selector_reward_observations: > 0
  selector_policy_updates: > 0
  learned_vs_fixed_delta_accepts
  learned_vs_fixed_delta_tokens
  learned_vs_fixed_delta_cost
  learned_vs_fixed_delta_false_accepts
  selector_learning_shadow_only: true
  local_accept_enabled: false

PASS only if:
  learned selector beats or matches fixed_greedy on future/shadow window
  false_accepts == 0
  runtime parity clean
  exact-cache overlap excluded
  product/local_accept remains disabled

WATCH if:
  selector is automatic but fixed_greedy
  selector has no policy updates
  selector has no future-window comparison against fixed_greedy
```

VISUAL PROOF REQUIRED:

```text
Build an XY curve that shows how selector quality changes as L4 chooses
bucket after bucket.

Production boundary:
  this visual proof must be OFF in production hot path.
  It is allowed only in shadow/proof/diagnostic runs.
  Serving may expose counters, but not per-step curve generation.

X axis:
  selector step / selected bucket rank / time window

Y axis options, at minimum:
  cumulative unique accepts over exact cache
  cumulative tokens saved
  cumulative provider cost saved when evidence exists
  false_accepts
  cumulative overlap penalty
  hot bytes / latency budget

Compare at least two curves:
  fixed_greedy baseline
  learned_online selector

Artifacts required:
  learned_selector_curve.csv or .jsonl
  learned_vs_fixed_selector_curve.svg or .png
  report fields:
    curve_artifact_path
    fixed_greedy_curve_artifact_path
    learned_selector_curve_artifact_path
    curve_x_axis
    curve_y_axes

The graph is not decoration. It is proof that L4 choice changes the economics.
```

SUGGESTED FIRST IMPLEMENTATION:

```text
Do not overbuild RL.
Start with an online bandit-style policy:

state per bucket:
  attempts
  verified_accepts_over_cache
  tokens_saved
  cost_saved
  false_accepts
  overlap_count
  hot_bytes
  latency_ns
  learned_weight

reward:
  + new_unique_accepts_over_exact_cache
  + token_saved_weight * tokens_saved
  + cost_saved_weight * cost_saved
  - false_accept_penalty * false_accepts
  - overlap_penalty * overlap_count
  - hot_bytes_penalty * hot_bytes
  - latency_penalty * latency_ns

update:
  learned_weight <- learned_weight + eta * reward

selection:
  choose by learned_weight, with conservative exploration only in shadow.
```

VERDICT:

```text
This is not optional polish.
Fixed greedy selector is a scaffold.
Learned L4 selector is the critical money node.
```

Executor note:

```text
Do not implement streaming as repeated .nwpc compilation.
Do not implement operator memory as an unbounded store.

The intended product mechanism is:
  L2-resident mutable phase-center operator
  + bounded operator memory
  + L4 streaming goal-state/router/admission layer
  + admission/eviction queues
  + optional .nwpc snapshot/export only.

L4 is mandatory as the layer that reduces stream entropy before L3:
  L4 routes/budgets/admits/evicts/schedules.
  L3 learns the bounded drifting phase-center operator.
  L4 must not become answer authority or Codex-hardcode.

Required design boundary:
  HOT: 1-4 active profile shards per worker
  WARM: bounded process-memory registry
  COLD: disk snapshots for restart/deploy/audit/rollback

Every implementation must expose budgets:
  max_hot_bytes_per_worker
  max_hot_profiles_per_worker
  max_warm_profiles_per_process
  max_profiles_per_route
  max_operator_age_without_hits
  max_route_top_k
  min_tokens_saved
  min_accept_rate
  false_accepts_must_be_zero
```

```text
Meaning:
  cold adapter still parses phase-atom JSONL and builds the bounded verifier-
  bound snapshot, but the timed product lane is only:
    route_index + fixed phase_vector + PhaseCenterHotRuntime + scratch -> margin
  This is the P1 hot-path benchmark. It is not a miner/report/worker envelope.
  The append-window gate is closer to live daemon shape: a watermark trace
  builds and validates the bounded hot snapshot, then a later append window is
  scored through the same PhaseCenterHotRuntime without registry mutation,
  serving-profile writes, product promotion, local_accept, or market claims.
  The live-loop budget smoke is the mutable-store side of the same boundary:
  phase-atom JSONL is still only a cold source adapter, each parsed event enters
  PhaseCenterLiveOperatorStore as numeric route_id / bucket_id / atom_ids, the
  store scores before update, and the current exported hot view is checked
  separately from learning-time rejected buckets.
  The append live-loop smoke adds live append ingestion shape: after a
  watermark window, each append event is scored against the current hot view
  before it updates the mutable store; then the current hot view may refresh.
  It also evaluates an in-memory admission queue from verifier-bound shadow
  evidence without mutating the product registry.
```


```text

  expanding V26 batch unless needed only as daemon bootstrap
```

```text
runtime_margin_parity_mismatches = 0
```

```text
learn on past stream
test on future stream
```

its streaming proof must come from rows after M.

```text
for the online daemon.
```

```text
7. keep all promotion/local_accept/money claims disabled.
```

```text
|
+-- L2 motif / binding layer
|   |
|   +-- roles
|   +-- slots
|   +-- action motifs
|   +-- state/action/result atoms
|   +-- reusable motif centers
|
+-- L3 phase-center operator layer
|   |
|   +-- center of mass of a transition
|   +-- correct vs wrong/background separation
|   +-- transferable operator candidate
|   +-- quarantine .nwpc package
|   +-- shadow score / margin
|
+-- L4 streaming / goal-state layer
    |
    +-- active turn state
    +-- stream context
    +-- state_before / action / observable_result separation
    +-- verifier context
    +-- chooses which L3 candidate is eligible for shadow scoring
    +-- never acts as source_agent hardcode authority
```

FLOW:

```text
agent/event stream
|
+-- adapter emits universal event rows
|
+-- L4 streaming / goal-state packer
|   |
|   +-- active_turn_state atoms
|   +-- state_before atoms
|   +-- action atoms
|   +-- result atoms
|   +-- verifier atoms
|
+-- L1/L2 wave encoding
|   |
|   +-- surface atoms
|   +-- motif atoms
|   +-- role/action/result motifs
|
+-- L3 phase-center miner/runtime
|   |
|   +-- learned transition center
|   +-- margin against wrong/background
|   +-- shadow CPU accept candidate
|
+-- verifier / shadow gate
    |
    +-- false_accepts must be 0
    +-- exact cache overlap excluded
    +-- fallback if uncertain
```

BOUNDARY:

```text
We are building LLM Wave, not a hardcoded Live Agent router.

Allowed:
  adapter-specific parsing
  verifier plugins for concrete observable results
  report labels for discovered subroutes

Forbidden:
  hardcoded agent decision branches
  hardcoded operator stores
  source_agent as authority
  if update_plan then accept
  if exec_command then accept
  if route == artifact_progress then accept
```

KEY RULE:

```text
L4 is not a manual workflow engine.
L4 is the streaming context / goal-state wave layer that makes an event usable
by L3 phase-center operators.

L3 learns the transferable operator.
L4 supplies the structured temporal/context field.
```

VERDICT:

```text
Codex-specific ingestion is allowed.
Codex-specific operator architecture is not allowed.

  phase_streaming_cmd.rs mixes:
    Codex session parsing
    Codex event names
    generic phase atoms
    ranking
    mining
    shadow
    billing gates

This must not become the permanent architecture.
```

```text
agent-specific input
|
+-- adapter
|   |
|   +-- Codex adapter
|   +-- future Claude adapter
|   +-- future OpenAI Agents adapter
|   +-- future LangGraph/custom adapter
|
+-- Universal Nando Event Stream
    |
    +-- generic L4 stream packer
    +-- generic active_turn_state atoms
    +-- generic action/result/verifier atoms
    +-- generic phase-center mining
    +-- generic quarantine .nwpc
    +-- generic shadow replay
```

```text
Every adapter must emit the same shape:

event_id
session_id
turn_id / step_index
source_agent
source_schema_version

action_family
route_hint
state_before_atoms
action_atoms
result_atoms
verifier_atoms
verifier_label
request_fingerprint
exact_cache_key
token_cost evidence, if available

No raw prompt text.
No raw answer text.
No target_id/proof_rule authority.
No local_accept during mining.
```

CODE BOUNDARY:

```text
Allowed Codex-specific layer:
  read /home/ubu/.codex/history.jsonl
  read /home/ubu/.codex/sessions
  parse exec_command_end / update_plan / tool outputs

Forbidden generic-layer leak:

  if source_agent == codex then special mining path
  if source_agent == claude then special mining path
  if source_agent == openai_agents then special mining path
  if source_agent == langgraph then special mining path
  hardcoded agent registry inside the miner/runtime
  hardcoded operator stores for one workflow
```

NEXT IMPLEMENTATION SHAPE:

```text
Before adding more Codex-specific commands, introduce the boundary in reports
and code organization:

1. Codex adapter emits universal event rows.
2. Existing ranking/mining/shadow commands consume universal rows.
3. New agent_continue_execute work targets universal active_turn_state fields,
   not Codex-only function names.

```

SUCCESS CRITERIA:

```text

same generic ranking/mining/shadow path can consume:
  Codex-emitted universal rows today
  another adapter-emitted universal rows later

without changing phase-center runtime,
without changing .nwpc schema,
without adding Codex-specific accept logic,
without adding any agent-specific accept/mining branch in the generic layer.
```

AGENT HARD-CODE BAN:

```text
Agents are adapters, not architecture.

Allowed:
  adapter/codex -> universal event rows
  adapter/claude -> universal event rows
  adapter/openai_agents -> universal event rows
  adapter/custom_enterprise -> universal event rows

Forbidden:
```

## 2026-07-05 - Standing Rule: Live Online Phase-Center Compressor

Process to keep:

```text
LIVE DAEMON
|
+-- accepts real event stream
+-- measures class statistics:
|   repeat count, token cost, exact-cache overlap, verifier availability,
|   false-accept risk
+-- finds high-value classes:
|   high frequency, high token cost, low exact-cache overlap,
|   deterministic verifier
+-- runs online phase-center miner:
|   atoms -> action_family buckets -> center of mass -> quarantine .nwpc
+-- runs shadow gate:
|   accepts over exact cache, false_accepts = 0
+-- runs promotion gate:
    promote only stable verifier-bound candidates;
    otherwise keep fallback
```

Allowed:

```text
online learn:       yes
online shadow:      yes
auto promote:       only after gates
auto local_accept:  only after verifier + false_accepts=0 + limits
```

Forbidden:

```text
no .nwrb
no role-binding commercial backend
no hidden lookup
no target_id / proof_rule_id authority
no concrete_x_lookup
no manual local_out_t
no local_accept without verifier
```

Product direction:

```text
Nando must become a self-tuning CPU compressor for agent loops:
real traffic -> discover repeated operator class -> build phase-center candidate
-> shadow -> promote only if safe.
```

## 2026-07-05 - Reviewer Deep Diagnosis: v5 Is Not Stupid, It Is Missing Safe Result Atoms

Finding:

```text
v5 strict miner is not simply "too strict".
It is trying to learn safe_accept mostly from request/state/tool/action atoms,
while parse_phase_atom_binary_event_for_action currently ignores result_atoms.
```

Observed trace facts:

```text
trace row contains result_atoms:
  verifier_label:pass
  verified_safe_accept:true
  exit_code_band:zero
  output_hash64:...
  evidence:exit_code_zero
  evidence:ripgrep

false row contains:
  verifier_label:fail
  verified_safe_accept:false
  exit_code_band:positive_nonzero
  output_hash64:...
  evidence:nonzero_exit_status
  evidence:cargo_fmt
```

Current parser path:

```text
parse_phase_atom_binary_event_for_action
|
+-- includes:
|   |
|   +-- request_atoms
|   +-- state_atoms
|   +-- action_atoms
|   +-- tool_atoms
|   +-- route_hint_atoms
|
+-- excludes entirely:
    |
    +-- result_atoms
```

Effect:

```text
The safe/reject signal that is legally available after tool execution is mostly
not visible to the phase-center candidate.

So v5 sees many buckets like:
  command kind
  cwd kind
  output size bands
  weak error/warning markers

but it misses the clean post-tool status atoms:
  exit_code_band:zero
  exit_code_band:positive_nonzero
  exit_code_band:cargo_101
  evidence:exit_code_zero
  evidence:nonzero_exit_status
  evidence:nonzero_exit_error_marker
```

This explains the current v5 RED:

```text
compiled candidates: 14
accepted candidates: 0
top rejection: train_safe_accept_margin_overlap

Many compiled buckets show:
  train_safe_accept_min_true_margin <= train_safe_accept_max_false_margin

Meaning:
  true safe rows and false rows are not separable with the atoms currently fed
  into the candidate.
```

Important boundary:

```text
Do NOT add these result atoms:
  verifier_label:*
  verified_safe_accept:*
  output_hash64:*

Those would either leak the label or become output lookup.
```

Recommended fix:

```text
Add a safe_result_atoms filter and feed only non-leaky result atoms into
parse_phase_atom_binary_event_for_action:

allowed:
  exit_code_band:*
  evidence:exit_code_zero
  evidence:nonzero_exit_status
  evidence:nonzero_exit_error_marker
  maybe other coarse deterministic status evidence

forbidden:
  verifier_label:*
  verified_safe_accept:*
  output_hash64:*
  raw output text
```

Then rerun as a new rung:

```text
phase-atom-live-self-mining-loop-multifamily-v6-safe-result-atoms
```

What changed:

```text
1. Self-mining no longer treats verifier-false / reject rows as CPU accepts.
   Product CPU accepts now count only verifier-true safe accepts over exact cache.

2. The candidate .nwpc compiler now builds a single accept/fallback classifier:
     positive = verifier true safe-accept vectors
     negative = verifier false vectors
   This removed the previous label-selected shortcut where the evaluator already
   knew which label center to score.

3. Mining buckets are now narrower than action_family:
     action_family + selected request/state/tool/route atoms
   This moved discovery from 2 broad classes to 1475 repeated state/action
   buckets.

4. Candidate package filenames are short-stem + stable fingerprint, so rich
   bucket keys no longer hit filesystem filename limits.

5. Progress output is throttled:
     ranked class count
     selected compile classes
     periodic scan counters
   not one line for every bucket.
```

Important finding:

```text
The previous multi-family PASS was too soft for product admission.
It proved label-separable phase centers, not safe local accept.

After tightening admission:
  broad action_family buckets: false_accept risk / safe-margin overlap
  narrow state/action buckets: many real buckets found, but top buckets still
  fail train_safe_accept_margin_overlap or label-window diversity.

Therefore current real traffic traces contain repeated operator-shaped regions,
but the current atoms are not yet sufficient for verifier-bound local accept
promotion.
```

```text
Fixed the Codex-session tool-status extractor window. The previous v2 extractor
read current response_item tool-call/output rows, but stopped after the first
max_events rows in the freshest mtime file. That made the v2 append window new
relative to the old May watermark but not truly latest-current.

selects the newest max_events by event_timestamp, and writes the selected rows
back in chronological order. Raw request text, raw response text, and raw tool
output are still not written into the trace.

The v3-latest trace covers 2026-07-04T10:15:58.325Z through
2026-07-05T11:32:04.707Z and replays cleanly through the admitted .nwpc
phase-center runtime registry.
```

```text
Added CLI:
```

```text
  examples. Once it has enough events and at least two verifier labels, it
  compiles a quarantine .nwpc package. Only later events are shadow-scored for
  unique CPU accepts over exact cache.

  batch discovery: all rows -> compile -> heldout split
  online discovery: earlier rows -> compile -> future rows only
```

Purpose:

```text
Describe the streaming reducibility mechanism:
repeated state/action/result transitions
-> phase vectors
-> online center-of-mass buckets
-> candidate operator center
-> shadow verifier
-> .nwpc package
-> promote only if false_accepts=0
```

Required content:

```text
1. Reducibility theorem:
   an operator is reducible when its transitions form a stable phase center
   that transfers to heldout states and separates correct from wrong with margin.

2. Streaming data structure:
   bucket_key
   sum_pos
   sum_neg
   count_pos
   count_neg
   recent_ring_buffer
   coherence / variance
   p10_margin
   false_accepts

3. Online update:
   v = encode(state, action, result)
   bucket.sum += v
   center = normalize(bucket.sum)

4. Candidate gate:
   count >= N
   variance <= threshold
   p10_margin >= threshold
   shadow false_accepts = 0

5. First MVP candidate:
   test_output_parse stream
   state = stdout/tool output
   action = parse test result
   result = pass/fail/error summary
   verifier = stdout itself

6. Boundary:
   online discovery is allowed
   online local accept without verifier is forbidden
```

```text
no .nwrb
no role-binding runtime
no payload-builder/verifier/catalog backend revival
no local accept without verifier
no hidden lookup
no target/proof authority
no phase_center_runtime.rs edits in this step
```

## 2026-07-04 - Executor Integration: Local-Accept Calibration Anti-Loop V1

Verdict:

```text
CPU_OPERATOR_CATALOG_V1_REVIEW_LOCAL_ACCEPT_FAILURES_AND_LOW_SUPPORT_DOWNRANKED
```

What changed:

```text
Updated:
  crates/nando-cli/src/role_binding_runtime_cmd.rs

The CPU operator catalog now distinguishes two non-promotable local-accept
states:

  local_accept_calibration_failed:
    calibration ran, but no zero-false safe policy exists.

  local_accept_support_insufficient:
    a zero-false policy exists, but true support is below the minimum support
    gate and must stay review-only.

Both states now receive priority penalties. This prevents the catalog from
looping on routes whose current score geometry cannot produce robust verified
CPU savings.
```

Decision:

```text
Do not lower thresholds for read_inspect. Current margins do not separate
verifier-true from verifier-false rows.

Do not promote singleton/low-support planning_next_step or retrieval_lookup
policies as product savings. They need more verifier-true support or better
request-side admission before promotion.

The next actionable work shifts to route-gap families that need real builders
and deterministic verifiers instead of more threshold passes:
  agent_continue_execute
  retrieval_lookup route-gap
  short_decision_ack
  style_brevity
```

```text
The important finding is negative:
  agent-control has real routable pressure, but a one-edge shared control
  profile is not a safe local-accept policy.

A quick request-side admission probe found no simple zero-false subset:
  stop_tokens_le_2: 31 accepted -> 10 true / 14 false / 7 missing
  stop_exact: 12 accepted -> 2 true / 10 false / 0 missing
  short_ack_tokens_le_1: 28 accepted -> 0 true / 26 false / 2 missing

So the next engineering route is not threshold tuning. It is one of:
  split stop / ack / continue into separate profile routes;
  attach real agent-state or tool-state evidence;
  add a no-mutating-tool-after-stop verifier;
  keep continue as fallback until active-goal state can prove the next step.
```

## 2026-07-03 - Executor Integration: Real Traffic Shadow Recorder And Operator Mining

Verdict:

```text
REAL_TRAFFIC_SHADOW_V1_READY
SYNTHETIC_SMOKE_FORCES_REVIEW
```

What changed:

```text
Added three CLI commands:
  role-binding-real-traffic-record-v1
  role-binding-real-traffic-record-serve-v1
  role-binding-real-traffic-ingest-events-v1
  role-binding-real-traffic-codex-history-ingest-v1
  role-binding-real-traffic-codex-history-route-candidates-v1
  role-binding-real-traffic-shadow-v1
  role-binding-real-traffic-shadow-smoke-v1

The new path records JSONL trace rows without changing the live LLM flow,
then analyzes the trace in shadow mode against serving-only `.nwrb` profiles.
It computes exact-cache baseline, Nando routability, verified local accepts,
fallbacks, false accepts, latency/RSS, and operator rankings.

The HTTP recorder exposes GET /health, POST /trace, and GET /metrics with an
optional request limit, so smoke/watchdog runs can stop without leaving a
hanging daemon.

The event ingester converts agent/API event JSONL into the trace contract and
keeps synthetic/no-candidate batches in REVIEW.

The Codex history ingester converts local Codex prompt history into
privacy-safe event fingerprints. It writes no raw text and does not infer
`nando_shadow_request`.

The Codex history route-candidate adapter selects route/profile candidates from
request-side prompt text only. It writes empty score payloads, so every candidate
must fallback until a real `active_fringe`/slot builder exists.

Bugfix: REAL_TRAFFIC_SHADOW_V1_PASS now requires `verified_safe_accepts > 0`
and `incremental_savings_over_exact_cache > 0`. Candidate-only/no-savings traces
stay REVIEW.
```

Key boundary:

```text
Synthetic savings are not market savings.
Synthetic traces force REAL_TRAFFIC_SHADOW_V1_REVIEW even if reduction is high.
Market claim requires non-synthetic real traffic with verified_safe_accept=true
and false_local_accepts=0.
```

```text
compression operators. This rung creates the measurement path that can discover
the money-ranked operators from real traces. The next proof is real agent/API
traffic in shadow mode, not another synthetic savings claim.

candidates. That means the next engineering debt is a real route/candidate
adapter, not more synthetic replay.

builds no executable payload and therefore saves 0 calls. The next debt is the
request-side builder for active fringe and slot impulses.
```

No SSH was used for this rung.

## 2026-07-06 - Hot Path Split And Lean Event Adapter

Reviewer/user rule accepted:

```text
Cold path can be smart and heavy.
Hot path must be dumb, numeric, and instant.
```

Architecture split:

```text
proof/cold path:
  trace / JSONL / reports / verifier / calibration / .nwpc emission

product/hot path:
  u32 route_id or profile_id
  prepared phase vector
  PhaseCenterHotRuntime::score_profile()
  margin compare
  accept/fallback policy outside score loop
```

Implemented core API:

```text
PhaseCenterAtomEncoder
  reusable scratch buffer
  safe atoms -> phase vector
  adapter/cold boundary only

PhaseCenterOnlineEvent
  bucket_id: u32
  vector: &[PhaseCenterCell]
  verified_safe_accept: bool
  exact_cache_hit: bool
  tokens: u64
  cost_microusd: u64

PhaseCenterOnlineCandidatePackage
  bucket_id
  threshold_micro
  package_info
  package_bytes

PhaseCenterOnlineMiner::observe_event()
PhaseCenterOnlineMiner::observe_atoms()
PhaseCenterOnlineMiner::observe_events_into()
PhaseCenterOnlineMiner::candidate_hot_runtime()
PhaseCenterOnlineMiner::candidate_package_bytes()
PhaseCenterOnlineMiner::candidate_packages_into()

PhaseCenterPromotionEvidence
PhaseCenterPromotionDecision
PhaseCenterPromotionBlocker
```

Hot path guard:

```text
PhaseCenterHotRuntime::score_profile() takes:
  profile_index: usize
  vector: &[PhaseCenterCell]

It does not parse JSON, read files, write logs, build reports, run verifier
replay, compile checkpoints, use String bucket keys, or touch .nwrb.

It also does not encode string atoms. PhaseCenterAtomEncoder is for the
adapter/cold boundary before hot scoring.

Source adapters may use observe_atoms() to send verifier-safe atoms into the
online miner. This still stays outside PhaseCenterHotRuntime scoring.

candidate_hot_runtime() exports only unrejected buckets that already produced
unique CPU accepts over exact cache. This is a local hot snapshot bridge, not
promotion or local_accept.

Promotion eligibility is now a typed core gate. A candidate is eligible only
after future shadow evidence, positive unique accepts over exact cache,
positive token/cost savings, false_accepts=0, runtime parity=0, exact-cache
overlap excluded, token/cost denominator present, and local_accept still
disabled.
```

## 2026-07-06 - Reviewer Hint: Marginal Denominator Selector

Problem:

```text
V26 auto-subcenter selected locally pretty buckets, but product denominator collapsed:
  V21: 4537 accepts / 12.66% calls saved
  V26:  328 accepts /  0.30% calls saved

Root cause:
  selector optimizes local bucket quality, not marginal product value.
```

Required next mechanism:

```text
Implement a marginal-denominator selector in the L4/admission layer.
Do not change L3/phase-center scoring first.
```

Selector contract:

```text
Input:
  candidate profiles / buckets
  compatible or global denominator events
  exact-cache keys
  verifier labels
  per-event token/cost evidence when present
  hot byte / profile budget

For each candidate:
  replay against denominator
  count only events not already covered by selected candidates
  subtract exact-cache overlap
  reject candidate if false_accepts > 0
  compute marginal_calls_saved
  compute marginal_tokens_saved
  compute marginal_cost_saved
  compute hot_bytes_delta
  compute overlap_with_selected
```

Selection rule:

```text
selected = []
covered_event_keys = {}
while budget remains:
  choose candidate with best positive marginal value:
    value = new_calls_saved_weighted
          + new_tokens_saved_weighted
          + new_cost_saved_weighted
          - hot_bytes_penalty
          - latency_penalty
          - overlap_penalty

  add candidate
  mark its covered event keys
  recompute marginal delta for remaining candidates
```

Required report fields:

```text
selector_kind: marginal_denominator_greedy_v1
denominator_total_rows
candidate_count
selected_count
rejected_false_accept_count
rejected_zero_marginal_count
rejected_budget_count
exact_cache_overlap_removed
selected_unique_accepts_over_exact_cache
selected_calls_saved_pct
selected_tokens_saved_pct
selected_hot_bytes_estimate
selected_latency_p99_ns if measured
per_candidate:
  local_bucket_score
  raw_accepts
  marginal_accepts
  overlap_accepts
  exact_cache_hits
  false_accepts
  hot_bytes_delta
  selected_rank or rejection_reason
```

PASS/WATCH boundary:

```text
PASS:
  false_accepts = 0
  selected_unique_accepts_over_exact_cache > V21 baseline 4537 on comparable denominator
  selected_calls_saved_pct > 12.66 on comparable denominator
  selected_hot_bytes_estimate within budget
  local_accept_enabled = false
  market_money_claim_allowed = false unless provider billing is real

WATCH:
  denominator is not comparable to V21
  selected improves local score but not global denominator
  selector uses post-hoc labels as answer authority
  product path still depends on JSONL/BTreeMap/.nwpc compile in request scoring
```

Architecture note:

```text
This is L4/admission, not a new L3 mechanism.
L3 produces candidate phase centers.
L4 chooses the non-overlapping, high-value, verifier-safe set to keep hot in CPU.
```

## 2026-07-06 - Reviewer Hint: Self-Learning L4 Selector

Correction to previous selector hint:

```text
The fixed value formula is only a baseline.
It is not the final mechanism, because A/B/C/penalties are hand-chosen.
```

Required direction:

```text
Build a self-learning L4 selector.
L3 produces candidate phase centers.
L4 learns which candidates are worth keeping hot from future shadow outcomes.
```

Allowed ladder:

```text
v1 baseline:
  fixed marginal-denominator greedy selector
  purpose: prove V26 collapse is a selector-objective bug

v2 learned value weights:
  train weights from historical shadow windows
  no local_accept
  no product promotion

v3 online contextual bandit:
  exploit proven winners
  explore a small bounded budget of new candidates
  promote only after verifier + false_accepts=0 + denominator proof
```

Training data for L4 selector:

```text
For each candidate on a shadow window, record features before final selection:
  raw_accepts
  marginal_accepts_over_selected
  exact_cache_overlap
  overlap_with_selected
  verifier_true_count
  verifier_false_count
  false_accepts
  max_false_margin
  p10/median margin
  route_id / action_family / bucket_family
  hot_bytes_delta
  latency_p99_ns if measured
  age / freshness / drift counters
  tokens_saved
  cost_saved

Label from future shadow window:
  useful = candidate produced positive marginal accepts with false_accepts=0
  target_value = marginal_cost_saved or marginal_tokens_saved over exact cache
```

Self-learning scoring:

```text
learned_value = model(features)

Start simple and auditable:
  linear/ridge/logistic score over numeric features
  monotonic constraints where obvious:
    false_accepts hurts
    exact_cache_overlap hurts
    hot_bytes hurts
    marginal_accepts helps
    verified future savings helps

No neural black box yet.
```

Bandit policy later:

```text
HOT budget split:
  80-90% exploit selected proven profiles
  10-20% explore high-uncertainty/high-upside candidates

Explore candidates stay shadow-only.
Exploration cannot enable local_accept.
```

Required report fields:

```text
selector_kind: learned_l4_value_selector_v1
baseline_fixed_greedy_calls_saved_pct
learned_selector_calls_saved_pct
learned_selector_tokens_saved_pct
false_accepts
selected_count
explore_count
exploit_count
feature_importance_or_weights
train_window
future_shadow_window
candidate_count
selected_hot_bytes_estimate
```

PASS boundary:

```text
PASS only if learned selector beats fixed greedy and V21 baseline on comparable denominator:
  false_accepts = 0
  calls_saved_pct > 12.66
  tokens_saved_pct >= V21 or explain tradeoff
  hot bytes within budget
  local_accept_enabled = false
  market_money_claim_allowed = false unless provider billing is real
```

Important architecture wording:

```text
This is not a new L3 phase-center mechanism.
This is L4 learning an admission/value policy over L3 candidate operators.
```

## 2026-07-06 - Reviewer Plan: Streaming Automatic Operator Process

Goal:

```text
real stream
  -> automatically find high-value classes
  -> build candidate phase centers
  -> shadow-verify future events
  -> select bounded hot set
  -> allow local_accept only after verifier + false_accepts=0 + denominator proof
```

Current status:

```text
Phase centers can already learn online.
Frontier shadow replay has crossed 20% calls saved in shadow:
  22.32% calls saved
  72.05% tokens saved
  false_accepts = 0

But class discovery and hot-set selection are still not fully automatic.
```

Implementation ladder:

```text
A. Unified event schema
B. Live class opportunity board
C. Auto candidate builder
D. Online PhaseCenter miner
E. Marginal denominator selector
F. Self-learning L4 value selector
G. Hot set manager
H. Shadow daemon
I. Promotion gate
J. Controlled local_accept
```

A. Unified event schema:

```text
event_id
timestamp
agent_source
route_hint
state_atoms
action_atoms
result_atoms
verifier_label
exact_cache_key
tokens
cost
```

Rule:

```text
Codex-specific logic belongs only in adapters.
Core/L4 selector must consume source-neutral event fields.
```

B. Live class opportunity board:

```text
For each class / route / bucket family, continuously track:
  traffic_count
  exact_cache_hits
  cache_misses
  token_weight
  cost_weight
  verifier_label_rate
  safe_atom_rate
  false_accept_history
  current_cpu_accepts
  missed_safe_accepts_estimate
```

Output:

```text
ranked_class_opportunities
next_best_class
expected_marginal_accepts
missing_evidence_reason
recommended_next_action
```

C. Auto candidate builder:

```text
For top opportunities, build candidate buckets automatically:
  route_id
  bucket_id
  safe_atom_ids
  positive examples
  negative/background examples
```

Boundary:

```text
No .nwpc compile per request.
No product local_accept.
Candidates are mutable phase centers in RAM first.
```

D. Online PhaseCenter miner:

```text
Input:
  route_id + bucket_id + atom_ids + verifier_label + exact_cache flag + tokens/cost

Behavior:
  score_before_update
  update positive/negative center
  calibrate threshold from false margins
  reject bucket on false_accept
```

E. Marginal denominator selector:

```text
Select candidates by real product delta, not local beauty:
  new accepts over exact cache
  minus overlap with selected
  minus false_accept risk
  minus hot_bytes / latency cost
```

F. Self-learning L4 value selector:

```text
Train from historical shadow windows:
  features(candidate) -> future_marginal_value

Start simple:
  linear/ridge/logistic transparent model
  feature weights reported
  no neural black box initially
```

Features:

```text
raw_accepts
marginal_accepts
exact_cache_overlap
overlap_with_selected
verifier_true_count
verifier_false_count
false_accepts
max_false_margin
p10/median margin
route_id/action_family/bucket_family
hot_bytes_delta
latency_p99_ns
age/freshness/drift
tokens_saved
cost_saved
```

G. Hot set manager:

```text
HOT:
  1-4 active shards per worker

WARM:
  bounded candidate registry

COLD:
  snapshots / audit / rollback
```

Update cadence:

```text
Do not rebuild hot set per request.
Update every N events or every T seconds.
```

H. Shadow daemon:

```text
Every candidate first runs shadow-only:
  score event
  compare verifier
  count false_accepts
  count marginal savings
  count exact-cache overlap
```

I. Promotion gate:

```text
Candidate may enter product hot set only if:
  future shadow passed
  false_accepts = 0
  runtime parity = 0
  exact-cache overlap excluded
  token/cost denominator present
  verifier binding present
  hot bytes within budget
```

J. Controlled local_accept:

```text
Only after promotion gate.
Never during exploration.
Never from score alone.
Verifier remains authority for admission safety.
```

Required metrics board per window:

```text
global_cpu_calls_saved_pct
global_tokens_saved_pct
false_accepts
wrong_wins
new_classes_found
classes_promoted
classes_rejected
hot_bytes
warm_bytes
p99_latency
exact_cache_overlap
provider_billing_evidence_present
market_money_claim_allowed
```

Short architecture formula:

```text
L3 learns transferable phase-center operators.
L4 learns which operators to keep hot.
Verifier decides which operators may be trusted.
```

## 2026-07-06 - Time-Split Numeric Online Miner Lane

Change:

```text
PhaseCenterOnlineMiner now keeps calibration open until each active bucket has seen a verified false margin.

Old risk:
  a bucket could finish calibration on positive-only active events,
  keep threshold near the floor,
  then treat the first high-margin false event as a raw local operator.

New rule:
  calibration_event remains true while max_calibration_false_margin_micro is missing.
  The first verified false active event raises the learned threshold instead of becoming a false shadow accept.
```

Why:

```text
Threshold must be an output of the online miner from observed false margins.
It must not be a manual CLI knob or a fixed product threshold.
```

## 2026-07-07 - P0 Selected Split NWPC: Bounded Auto Multi-Split Added

VERDICT:

```text
Auto multi-split is now a real cold-path mechanism, not a manual package list.
It expands selected broad classes into multiple observable-atom subcenters,
compiles each as verifier-bound .nwpc, then relies on promotion/replay/portfolio
gates for zero false accepts and global unique accepts over exact cache.

This is still shadow only. local_accept remains disabled.
```

Implementation:

```text
command:
  phase-stream-selected-split-nwpc-quarantine-v1 ... --auto-multi-split

code:
  crates/nando-cli/src/phase_streaming_cmd/selected_split_nwpc.rs

new behavior:
  selected_split_source_mode = auto_observable_atom_multi_split_v1
  auto_multi_split_top_k = 16
  seed selected_children are preserved
  extra sub-splits are generated as all::<observable_atom>
  context/token/cost atoms are excluded from auto sub-split selection
  derived planning contrast atoms are allowed
```

Why bounded:

```text
An unbounded 65-subsplit attempt was stopped because it was too heavy for the
cold proof path. The mechanism now uses a fixed top-16 observable atom budget
plus derived contrasts. Progress is printed every 4 packages for large sets.
```

## 2026-07-07 - P0 Portfolio Replay Recount + Billing Boundary

VERDICT:

```text
Portfolio-selected .nwpc reports can now be replayed as recount evidence.
For portfolio promotion reports, per-package historical decision counts are
not treated as required parity, because global replay over the current input
set is the authority. Package fingerprint/bytes/records parity and
false_accepts=0 remain mandatory.

This fixes the schema/evidence mismatch between:
  package-level source replay reports
  portfolio-selected promotion reports
  combined runtime replay + billing request
```

Code:

```text
crates/nando-cli/src/phase_streaming_cmd/selected_split_nwpc_shadow_replay.rs

new report fields per package:
  decision_count_parity_required
  expected_unique_accepts_over_exact_cache
  expected_tokens_saved
  expected_cost_saved_microusd
```

Why:

```text
A direct replay of the portfolio promotion report initially failed with:
  replay_mismatch_count: 4

The cause was not false accepts or package corruption. It was count parity
being applied to a portfolio-selected report whose per-package counts came from
source replay evidence, while the combined replay recomputes exact-cache and
unique accepts over the current full input set.
```

## 2026-07-08 - Architecture Task: Apply "NE BUSY" Layers To Online Miner

REFERENCE:

```text
docs/NE_BUSY_ARCHITECTURE.md
```

TASK:

```text
Do not treat this as another heuristic patch.

Refactor the online miner decision logic toward the NE BUSY layer contract:

  L1 -> surface atoms
  L2 -> hidden state split
  L3 -> phase-center operator
  L4 -> portfolio survivor selector
  verifier -> admission / quarantine
```

WHY:

```text
The current failure mode shows that broad buckets still mix different hidden
states:

  agent_continue_execute / planning / positive_nonzero

can contain both:
  safe transferable sub-transitions
  poisoned unsafe sub-transitions

The correct architecture is not:
  bad bucket -> kill all hot runtime

The correct architecture is:
  broad bucket -> L2 hidden-state split -> L3 centers -> L4 portfolio survivors
```

PIPELINE TARGET:

```text
real event stream
  |
  +-- L1 surface atoms
  |     command_kind
  |     tool_kind
  |     exit_code_band
  |     output_shape
  |     cwd/project-neutral atoms
  |
  +-- L2 hidden state split
  |     separates:
  |       sed edit
  |       shell inspect
  |       cargo/test parse
  |       git status/report sync
  |       positive_nonzero risky branch
  |       unknown mixed branch
  |
  +-- L3 phase-center operator
  |     learns center for each hidden transition
  |     keeps positive/negative evidence
  |     emits margin and verifier-bound package candidate
  |
  +-- L4 portfolio selector
        picks clean survivors by marginal denominator value
        quarantines only poisoned profiles
        keeps clean profiles hot
        reports lost tokens/calls from quarantined profiles
```

STRICT REQUIREMENTS:

```text
1. No agent hardcode in generic core.
   Codex/Claude/etc must stay adapters, not decision authority.

2. No manual class list as product logic.
   Manual lists may be diagnostics only.

3. Selector must be learned/automatic from stream evidence:
     marginal unique accepts over exact cache
     marginal tokens/cost saved
     false_accepts
     verifier readiness
     overlap
     hot byte budget

4. Quarantine must be local:
     bad profile -> quarantine
     clean sibling profiles -> stay hot

5. Product-hot runtime must remain score-only:
     no JSONL
     no heavy mining
     no provider billing
     no cold artifact writes
     no local_accept

6. Promotion/admission still requires:
     verifier bound
     false_accepts = 0
     negative/background evidence
```
